messages:
Alex Torres: Heads-up — starting a short thread to scope the Q3–Q4 security & compliance roadmap. Focus areas: SOC2 evidence automation, audit-log retention/export, KMS/HSM options, and customer-driven retention SLAs. Can we list must-haves, launch criteria, and rough prioritization? Planning sync Tue 11am.

Priya Khatri: thanks — high-level asks from customers so far: (1) tenant-isolated audit exports for auditors, (2) 7+ year archive for finance customers, (3) BYOK/KMS integration + HSM for enterprise FIPs needs, (4) easy evidence bundles for SOC2. Launch criteria should include automated evidence generation + security signoff.

Jamal Ortiz: agree with Priya. Implementation note: HSM onboarding is heavy — propose staged rollout: cloud KMS integration (low lift) -> BYOK w/ customer-managed keys -> dedicated HSM offering. Each stage needs key rotation, audit trail, and key custody docs. Rough timeline: cloud KMS (2 sprints), BYOK (4 sprints), HSM pilot (6+ sprints).

Emily Chen: for audit logs infra, two major tradeoffs: long-term object storage (S3 + Glacier + lifecycle) vs searchable cluster (ES/Opensearch) for fast queries. We can store compressed, signed log bundles in S3 with object-lock for immutability and keep an index in BigQuery for queries. That keeps costs down but supports auditor queries via export job. Example lifecycle snippet: ```json
{"Rules": [{"ID": "archive-7yr","Prefix": "audit/","Status": "Enabled","Transitions": [{"Days": 30,"StorageClass": "STANDARD_IA"},{"Days": 365,"StorageClass": "GLACIER"}],"Expiration": {"Days": 2555}}]}```

Priya Khatri: useful. For SOC2 evidence, we need reproducible export steps and a way to map evidence to control IDs. Launch checklist proposal (minimal):
```
- integration tests for export (automated)
- retention policy config per-tenant
- encryption at rest with KMS (customer-key opt-in)
- proof of immutability for archived logs
- SOC2: evidence artifact generation + reviewer workflow
- security review & threat model sign-off
```

Jamal Ortiz: adding technical acceptance criteria: key rotation policy enforced, HSM connection test & attestation, audit logs contain key usage events, and retention enforcement is automated (no manual deletion by ops).

sec-bot: policy-check: retention-config missing `object_lock_enabled` on draft branch #sec-retention.

Emily Chen: noted. I'll add object-lock as default in the infra module and open a PR for review. Also need to decide query SLA for exports — do auditors expect interactive querying or batched exports? Input from product / sales pls.

Priya Khatri: sales input: auditors usually want downloadable bundles; some customers (~10%) want interactive query for narrow windows. So default export + ad-hoc paid interactive option sounds right.

Alex Torres: good tradeoffs. Action items: Jamal owns KMS/BYOK/HSM path, Emily owns audit log infra + export flow, Priya will own launch criteria + customer comms. Please post rough timelines by EOD Fri so I can fold into roadmap slides. Also include known risks & mitigation (cost, ops, compliance signoff).

Jamal Ortiz: I'll post timelines and risk list by EOD Fri. Happy to pair with Emily on export schema.

Emily Chen: will do — PR for object-lock and lifecycle rule by tomorrow. I'll also prototype an export job that zips, signs, and uploads to tenant bucket.

Priya Khatri: I'll draft the SOC2 evidence mapping doc and customer FAQs. Will ping legal for retention legality checks for EU customers.

Alex Torres: perfect — thanks everyone. If anyone has blockers before Tue sync, drop them here. :thumbsup:
